Interesting! Those are 404 for me, even though indexes showed them. So document service is scoped per job: only documents relevant to my job are "found". Alder docs and BIRCH-EAST docs return 404. Birch-Storage quote is "found" (503), i.e., relevant to my job but backend unavailable. So the outage is specific to that one document for my job — likely deliberate.

Maybe it's a transient "download unavailable" that should eventually resolve? Try a few final attempts spread out. Let's use sleep 25 x2 then read.
